title: 2023 AMC 10B Problem 13
statement: What is the area of the region in the coordinate plane defined by the inequality \[\bigl||x| - 1\bigr| + \bigl||y| - 1\bigr| \le 1?\]

solutions.text: Substitute \(u = |x|,\) \(v = |y|.\) Then \(|u - 1| + |v - 1| \le 1\) is a diamond centered at \((1, 1)\) with diagonals of length \(2,\) so it has area \(2,\) and it sits entirely in \(u, v \ge 0.\) The map \((x, y) \mapsto (|x|, |y|)\) is four-to-one over \(u, v \gt 0,\) so the full region has area \(4 \times 2 = 8.\) Thus, B is the correct answer.
hints: Substitute \(u = |x|\) and \(v = |y|;\) then \(|u - 1| + |v - 1| \le 1\) is a diamond
Reflecting the first-quadrant piece across both axes copies it \(4\) times
